An [[Otolla/Legends|Otolla]] [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] '''observer''' lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. From the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], the Gungan served the Republic as an observer during a [[Battle of Drongar|battle]] on the planet [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]]<ref name="MedStar I" /> in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> However, the Gungan was hit in the mouth by a [[Sonic weapon/Legends|sonic]] [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] shot from a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]]; the injury left his buccal cavity severely varicosed. The Gungan was brought to the [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit 7]], where he was operated on by the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Doctor/Legends|surgeon]] [[Leemoth]].<ref name="MedStar I" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Gungan had a brief appearance in ''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]'', the first novel of the [[MedStar Duology]]. ''Battle Surgeons'' was written by [[Michael Reaves]] and [[Steve Perry]] and published in [[2004]].<ref name="MedStar I" />
